docstring: Some number field other than the rational numbers and the imaginary quadratic fields has a maximal abelian extension generated by the periodic points of one flat separated scheme of finite type with a Λ-structure over its ring of integers. This is Question 4 of Borger and de Smit, a precise question in the spirit of Hilbert 12. The authors state no expected answer.
references: [Borger and de Smit, Explicit class field theory and the algebraic geometry of Λ-rings](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.02295)
[Gurney, Elliptic curves with complex multiplication and Λ-structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.08674)
